consumer_proof.skill_fallback: BANK3A routine at ROM ~0x3A8FC0 computes lookup index; miss forces BX=0x000C then SHR BX => AX=6. Routine at ~0x3A9083 indexes far pointer 6000:5DAA, whose entry 6 points to 0x5E3A.
consumer_proof.weapon_orb_fallback: BANK3A routine at ROM ~0x3A929E searches a 6-key list through 6000:5D34; miss forces BX=0x000C. It then indexes 6000:5E44 and 6000:5E8E with that byte offset, selecting entry 6 => 0x5E84 and 0x5EF4.
consumer_proof.mixed_record: 0x365E44 is not a string: it is seven little-endian uint16 pointers [5E52,5E5A,5E62,5E6A,5E72,5E7A,5E84].
